long: SSX 3 is an arcade snowboarding game set on a single seamless mountain split into three peaks, which can be ridden top to bottom in one continuous run. Riders chain grinds, flips and Uber tricks to fill a boost meter, competing in race, slopestyle, big-air and backcountry events while unlocking gear and new characters. Local play is 2-player split screen.
name: SSX 3
